How a preacher earns
01
Share your link
Post it, DM it, put it in your bio. Anyone who opens it is tagged to you for 30 days — their game-coin purchases earn you a cut.
02
They buy game coins
When a referral buys game coins, you get your tier share — 28%, 36% or 44% — of the whole purchase. The buyer never pays extra: every coin pack splits 12% to the Reserve · 12% to running the Dojo · your tier share · and the rest to the weekly Pot (what your tier doesn't take goes to the Pot, so the players win it). Mining fees and NFT sales don't pay preachers — the 1% mining fee goes to the Reserve, royalties to the collection's Card Vault and the Reserve.
03
You get paid weekly
Earnings pool and pay out weekly, in the token that came in — what your referral paid with (ORE, SKR or SOL). Every tip and coin purchase is verified on-chain before a cent moves; buying through your own link never counts.
You earn on the coin purchases you refer (for 30 days per referral) — a referral program, not passive income for holding. Your cut is set by the fighters you have held for at least 7 days when each payment is verified (and locked in for that payment). The weekly Dojo Pot is a prize draw you enter by playing, never a dividend you're owed; chances come from your plays, ×2 when you hold 5+ fighters. Fees never add a charge to the buyer.
